messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: Hadoop Streaming jar not present
parts:
That's a known RStudio problem. You should set the variables in Renviron or with Sys.setenv on a per session basis. If you search around support.rstudio.org you should find more detail

Antonio
